comparison.objective: Place a non-slip mat beneath a heavy mixing bowl; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Tip-and-hold a bowl while inserting a mat versus simultaneous screw counterholding and jam-nut tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Bowl level on the mat without excessive tip or displacement versus retained angular setting over repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual stabilization is generic; the mechanisms and outcomes are different.
